scientific_integrity: The exact moments and sign inequalities are proved mathematically; finite enumerations are corroboration and are not exhaustive for unbounded n.
scientific_limitations: This concerns fixed local shapes in independent uniform noncrossing matchings. The signed bivariate Gaussian result does not imply a full three-dimensional or general shape-vector central limit theorem. Historical priority and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Orientation splitting and signed Gaussian decoupling for local meandric loops
